name: Rasterization-based Voxelization
definition: Converts a triangle mesh into a voxelized mesh representation by rasterizing triangles into a hash table of voxel centers and colors, then generating a cube mesh for each occupied voxel.
summary: Rasterization-based Voxelization converts triangle meshes into discrete volumetric representations by rasterizing triangles into voxel locations, differing from CPU-based geometric intersection methods by leveraging hash-based spatial mapping or GPU fragment shaders.
